---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard_long %>%
  filter(track %in%
    billboard_long %>%
    group_by(track) %>%
    summarise(best = min(rank)) %>%
    slice_min(best, n = 15) %>%
    pull(track)
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    week = readr::parse_number(week)
  ) %>%
  
  ggplot(
    aes(
      week,
      rank,
      color = track
    )
  ) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_y_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Rise and Fall of Billboard Hits",
    subtitle = "Chart trajectories of top-performing songs",
    x = "Weeks on Chart",
    y = "Billboard Rank"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22)
  )
```
